column1: Number of Form I-589, Application for Asylum and for Withholding of Removal
By Scheduled Interview Outcome, Office, Month
1 The number of applications in which the applicant appeared for their interview at the Asylum O?ce, and the Asylum O?cer conducted an asylum interview during the reporting period.

2 The number of applications in which the asylum interview is cancelled at the fault of USCIS, due to o?ce closures, unavailability of USCIS interpreters/officers, and COVID-illness related requests by applicants, etc. during the reporting period.
3 The number of applications in which the applicant submitted a request to reschedule their asylum interview and the Asylum O?ce honored the request during the reporting period.
4 The number of applications in which the applicant failed to appear for their scheduled asylum interview during the reporting period.
5 The number of applications without an interview outcome entry during the reporting period.
6 The number of applications in which the Asylum Officer conducted an interview with the applicant during the reporting period and a subsequent interview is needed.
1) Applications approved, denied, or pending a decision may have been received in previous reporting periods.
2) Applications may include more than one individual (i.e., a principal applicant and a spouse and/or child(ren) included on the application as dependents).
3) The report reflects the most up-to-date summary statistics available at the time the database is queried.
4) Counts may differ from previous periods due to system updates and post-adjudicative outcomes.
